gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i76: Verifies that for every proleptic year in [-200, 200), the first day of that year correctly reports its era, year-of-era, and round-trips through era-based cons
ADDED i77: Obtain January 1st of the given proleptic year via day-of-year index 1
ADDED i78: Proleptic year 0 and below map to the BC era; year 1 and above map to AD
ADDED i79: BC year-of-era counts upward from 1 as years go back: year 0 → BC 1, year -1 → BC 2, …
ADDED i80: Constructing the same date via (era, year-of-era, dayOfYear) must yield an equal date
